prompt: 帮我把刚才关于 TAGS.md 嵌套 tag 规则的讨论归档一下。我们讨论了嵌套 tag 是应该完全禁止还是允许自由组合，最后决定采用'顶层约束 + 嵌套自由组合'的方案，并更新了 TAGS.md 的 §1 命名规则、§3.5 红线清单、§4 脏 tag 清理表。

assertions.description: Frontmatter contains area:session, visibility:public, date, topic, tags, wiki_pages_touched
Body is 200-800 words with 背景/关键讨论/结论/产出物 sections
关键讨论 uses bullet points, not paragraphs
Identified TAGS.md as wiki-worthy and proposed update
Topic reflects nested tag rules discussion, not generic
